work.title: Readela 0.4.0: the release that brings Firefox for Android to readers: the version, the store copy, the packages of the frozen commit, the tag and the release, and a hand-off for both stores
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner choice of 2026-10-31, after the phone check, to release 0.4.0 now, and the owner's instruction of the same day that the store descriptions, the other documents, Personal OS and the Readela article on amir42.com say that Firefox for Android is added. It covers: raising the version to 0.4.0; the store listing kit, README, privacy policy and release notes for 0.4.0; the release checks; merging into main once the integration Gate passes; the packages and the source archive built from the frozen commit; a v0.4.0 tag and a release on that commit carrying the three archives; and a hand-off for the owner. It does not authorize: a change of what the extension does, requests, reads or stores; any store upload, submission or change of a live listing, which stay the owner's own steps; credentials, agreements or verifications of a provider.

parentPreflight.reason: That record placed the version number, the tag, the release and every store step out of scope. The release is that work, separately bounded and authorized, so it carries its own assertion, as the 0.2.1 and 0.3.0 releases did. The parent stays the record for what it covers and is not edited.

inScope: This record, committed first on the working branch from baseCommit.
package.json and package-lock.json: version 0.4.0. The manifests take the version from package.json at build time.
docs/store-listing.md, README.md and docs/privacy-policy.md: the copy, the release notes and the notes to reviewers for 0.4.0, the reviewer notes within AMO's 3,000-character field.
Dated evidence under docs/evidence/, a pull request, and its merge into main with the repository's merge method.

From the frozen commit on main: the Chrome and Firefox packages, the source archive, their digests, the release checks (verifier, unit tests, package contents, Mozilla's linter) and the end-to-end suite in desktop Chrome and Firefox.
An annotated tag v0.4.0 on the frozen commit and a release that carries the three archives and their digests.
A hand-off for the owner's submission to Firefox Add-ons (with Firefox for Android ticked) and to the Chrome Web Store, and the product page text to enter once the version is public.
outOfScope: Everything that is packaged other than the version number: what runs in a page, the popup, the background component, the manifests' other entries, permissions, match patterns, web-accessible resources, stored forms, fonts and icons.
The store images, which show nothing that 0.4.0 changes.
Any upload, submission or change of a live listing on either store.
The amir42.com website, which has its own repository and project.
The end-to-end harness for Firefox 159 and later.
Changes to declared Capabilities or Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.
